title: Ted Rice's story in Masquerade of Angels

tellings.quote: And then of course Masquerade of Angels, which documents the story of Ted Rice, who's still alive.

plain: The book Masquerade of Angels, by the writer Karla Turner, tells the story of a man named Ted Rice, who is still alive. Tim Alberino, a guest on the show, names the book in passing as one of the works recording such experiences, without saying more about what happened to Rice.
